fieldValues.title: Enforcement check for the versioning cell: Field allowedValues change requires a version increment
fieldValues.summary: Adds check-versioning-cell.mjs: diffs each Field definition file's own git history and requires version to increase whenever fieldType.allowedValues differs between two consecutive revisions of the same Field id. Registered in scripts/checks.json (always tier, versioning cell). Zero corpus violations at HEAD (545 Field files), no allowlist.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from the srs gate:pool queue via srs#580 tick 2026-09-06 20:1xZ. Fix in srs PR #655. Discovered during Work that the check is meaningless under the default actions/checkout shallow (fetch-depth 1) clone -- git log on any path returns only the tip commit, so a history-diffing check could never see two revisions. Fixed by adding fetch-depth: 0 to .github/workflows/validate.yml's checkout step. Proved by building two throwaway git repositories with real commit histories in tests/guards/run.mjs (versioningCellCases) and capturing red output on a deliberately crafted allowedValues change with no version bump, then green on the same change with the version incremented and on no change at all.
